text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I apologize, I've gained weight!
choice_data_list: ...I appreciate the honesty, but what's the reason?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Now then, what should I eat today—hm?
Seasonal Color Bowl... not a name I hear often.

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Worker
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, that one?
It's a limited-time rice bowl using seasonal ingredients!
It's delicious, nutritious, and highly recommended!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Then I definitely have to eat it!
The "Voice of Destiny" is telling me to do so, too!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: That seasonal bowl was truly delicious!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And then I realized.
How important it is to eat when you need to!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: And so, in search of seasonal delicacies, we toured famous restaurants—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: At times, I even traveled straight to the source to savor all kinds of ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"And as you can see, that resulted in quite a massive gain!
In short, I ate too much!"
choice_data_list: Considering that, you don't seem displeased at all.
Considering that, you don't seem displeased at all.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, don't you think? By my own will,
I continued to feast on in-season ingredients to my heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "I ended up gaining weight, but that's all there is to it."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, thanks to eating so much, energy is surging through my body!
I knew I was right all along!"
choice_data_list: ...I'll come up with a weight-loss plan that makes the most of that strength.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, much appreciated, Trainer!
With this seasonal boost, feels like I can do anything right now!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though the routine was set a bit on the harder side,
Epiphaneia handled it with ease and successfully slimmed down.
